verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਛੁਰਾ ਬਿਛੁਰ ਪਰੈ ਆਨ ਗਾਇ ਥਨ ਦੁਗਧ ਨ ਪਾਨ ਕਰੈ ਮਾਰਤ ਹੈ ਲਾਤ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise bachhuraa bichhur parai aan gai than dhugadh na paan karai maarat hai laat kee ||

en.bdb: Just as a calf separated from his mother rushes to suck milk from another cow's teats, and he is denied sucking milk by the cow who kicks him away.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਨਸਰ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਹੰਸ ਆਨ ਸਰ ਜਾਤ ਖਾਤ ਨ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਫਲ ਭੁਗਤ ਜੁ ਗਾਤ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise maanasar tiaag ha(n)s aan sar jaat khaat na mukataa fal bhugat ju gaat kee ||

en.bdb: Just as a swan leaving Mansarover lake goes to some other lake cannot get his food of pearls to eat from there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰ ਤਜਿ ਆਨ ਦੁਆਰ ਜਾਤ ਜਨ ਹੋਤ ਮਾਨੁ ਭੰਗੁ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise raaj dhuaar taj aan dhuaar jaat jan hot maan bha(n)g mahimaa na kaahoo baat kee ||

en.bdb: Just as a guard on the door of the king leaves and serves on another's door, it hurts his pride and does not help his glory and grandeur anyway.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਕੀ ਸਰਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਨ ਪਰਤ ਰਾਖਿ ਸਕਤ ਨ ਪਾਤਕੀ ॥੪੪੧॥
verses.translit_en: taise gursikh aan dhev kee saran jaeh rahio na parat raakh sakat na paatakee ||441||

en.bdb: Similarly, if a devoted disciple of Guru leaves the refuge of his Guru and goes into the protection of other gods and goddesses, he cannot find his stay there worthwhile nor anyone would show any respect and regard towards him being a blemished sinner.  (441)
